references.title: INE 2024 province statistical yearbooks
references.outcome: Each direct publisher-hosted URL timed out before any response bytes could be retrieved. Search index/catalog pages expose the yearbook titles and date only; no provincial roster assertions from these documents are relied on in province-assessments.csv.
references.license: Not verified; treat only as restoration leads. No document bytes are retained or redistributed.

references.title: Mapa do distrito de Ilha de Moçambique
references.finding: INE search-indexed map metadata reports source INE 2017 and shows a district context with the Ilha island plus mainland settlement Lúmbu and neighboring Mossuril; the direct file timed out before bytes were retrieved. Contextual island-risk lead only, not boundary approval.

references.title: Arquipélago das Quirimbas
references.finding: Government tourism page identifies Ibo among the Quirimbas islands; contextual island-risk lead only. It does not establish Ibo administrative boundaries or the district roster.
references.license: Not verified; web result only; no file retained.

references.title: Chilubi District – Northern Provincial Administration
references.publisher: Northern Province Administration, Government of Zambia
references.finding: Provincial Administration page places the district administration on Chilubi Island and describes the lake/island setting; contextual island-risk lead only. Direct download was rejected by local TLS certificate verification; TLS verification was not bypassed.
references.license: Not independently verified; web result only; no file retained.

references.title: Chilubi Town Council
references.publisher: Chilubi Town Council, Government of Zambia
references.finding: Council page states its headquarters are on Chilubi Island in Lake Bangweulu; contextual district role/island lead only. Direct download was rejected by local TLS certificate verification; TLS verification was not bypassed.
references.license: Not independently verified; web result only; no file retained.

references.title: 2017 Census INE microdata catalog
references.finding: The catalog reports 161 districts in the 2017 census and seven municipal districts in Maputo City; direct page retrieval timed out during phase 2. Treat as a dated count lead only.

references.title: INE avança com a cartografia censitária para o Censo 2027
references.finding: INE search-index result describes current 2027 census cartography over 161 districts; direct page retrieval timed out, so this is a restoration lead, not verified current roster evidence.

limits: The ZamStats source hash identifies the exact downloaded PDF bytes but the PDF is not redistributed; it must be restored and rehashed before reuse.
The INE yearbook links are research leads with no verified source hashes. They do not resolve the 159/161 Mozambique roster discrepancy or any province parent.

Official island-context web pages help identify Chilubi, Ilha de Moçambique and Ibo as specific geographic risk subjects; those unretained pages/PDF have no whole-file hash and do not support a boundary finding.
INE catalog and cartography pages supporting the 161-district count were not fetched as whole bytes and have no hashes; use them only as dated leads until restored, hashed and inspected under #1042.
